decision: Maintainer deferred dedicated performance optimization while animation correctness is repaired.
environment: Shared development laptop with concurrent Cargo builds; contended timings are diagnostic.

referenceTargets.label: Legacy diagnostic references, not current merge gates

requiredChecks: Animation continuity, contact, pose identity and finite-transform checks remain enforced.
Native rules, replay/profile binding, input mapping and viewport requirements remain enforced.
Backing resolution and work/state growth remain bounded.
Reproducible game-induced crashes, persistent freezes and runaway work still require correction.
deferredWork: Dedicated significance/update-rate and animation CPU optimization
Sustained matched desktop measurements on an otherwise quiet host
Named physical Android device and thermal measurements
limitations: An advisory result is not a performance pass.
Keep historical timings and their original target results unchanged.
Software rendering and shared-host timings do not establish physical-device performance.
